def solve_rect(g, mark, bg, fill=2):
    R,C=len(g),len(g[0])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if g[r][c]==mark]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts)
    c0=min(p[1] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for c in range(c0,c1+1):
        for r in (r0,r1):
            if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=fill
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in (c0,c1):
            if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=fill
    return out
